admin.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this?
admin.setupSub: One minute and customers can book you online.
admin.setupCodeHint: For your security: find this code in your server logs (the line starting with “Setup code”), or set the SETUP_CODE environment variable.
admin.invalidSetupCode: Wrong setup code — check your server logs
admin.sampleHint: You can edit or delete them later
admin.weakPassword: Password must be at least 8 characters
admin.loginSub: Enter your password to manage your bookings
admin.rateLimited: Too many attempts, please wait a bit
admin.authTagline: Your own booking page. No monthly fees, no commissions.
admin.authPoint1: Customers book 24/7 from a link or QR code
admin.authPoint2: Team calendars, time off and buffers handled for you
admin.nothingToday: Nothing booked today. Share your link to fill the calendar!
admin.remindersHint: Opens WhatsApp with a ready-made reminder.
admin.noReminders: All of tomorrow's customers have been reminded 🎉
admin.manualHint: For phone calls and walk-ins. Your booking rules don't apply here, but overlaps are still prevented.
admin.slotTaken: That time is no longer free
admin.name: Name
admin.bufferHint: Cleanup or rest time before the next booking
admin.noServicesYet: No services yet. Add your first one!
admin.noTeamYet: Working alone? Skip this — bookings are one at a time. Add people to take bookings in parallel.
admin.autoConfirmHint: Off = new bookings wait for you to confirm them
admin.policyPh: e.g. Please arrive 5 minutes early. Late arrivals may be shortened.
admin.backupHint: Download all your data as one file, or restore it on a new server.
admin.importConfirm: This replaces your current services, team and settings. Continue?
admin.invalidBackup: That file isn't a valid Mawid backup
admin.themeDesc_fresh: Clean and bright. Works for everything.
admin.themeDesc_soft: Pastel and rounded — lovely for salons and spas.
admin.themeDesc_elegant: Dark and classy, for premium studios.
admin.themeDesc_bold: Loud colours and thick outlines. Impossible to miss.
admin.previewHint: Changes show here instantly. Press Save to publish them.
admin.shareSub: Put it in your Instagram bio, on WhatsApp and on a QR at the reception.
admin.tip1: Add the link to your Instagram, TikTok and Google Maps profile.
admin.tip2: Send the link as your WhatsApp auto-reply.
admin.tip3: Remind tomorrow's customers every evening — it cuts no-shows a lot.
admin.tip4: Add a short break after long services so you're never rushed.
admin.notifyHint: Get a message on your phone the moment something new arrives — free, through your own Telegram bot.
admin.notifyStep1: In Telegram, open @BotFather, send /newbot and copy the token it gives you.
admin.notifyStep2: Paste the token below, then open your new bot and press Start.
admin.notifyStep3: Press “Find my chat”, then send a test.
admin.tokenSaved: Saved ({hint}) — paste a new one to replace it
admin.chatNotFound: No chat yet — open your bot in Telegram and press Start first.
admin.testFailed: Couldn’t send — check the token and chat ID
admin.testMessage: If you can read this, notifications are working 🎉
admin.invalidToken: That doesn’t look like a bot token
admin.depositPercentHint: 0 = no deposit. Bookings with a deposit wait until you mark it received.
admin.cxIntro: Optional add-ons. Everything works without them; connect only what you need.
admin.cxPaymentsHint: Let customers pay by card or wallet online. Payments are confirmed automatically — no more checking transfers by hand.
admin.cxCurrencyHint: Three letters, e.g. EGP, SAR, USD.
admin.cxStripeStep1: In Stripe → Developers → API keys, copy the secret key (sk_live_… or sk_test_… to try it).
admin.cxStripeStep2: Optional but recommended: add a webhook for the URL below with the event checkout.session.completed, and paste its signing secret.
admin.cxStripeWebhookHint: Confirms payments even if the customer closes the page before returning.
admin.cxPaymobStep1: In Paymob → Settings, copy your public key, secret key and HMAC secret.
admin.cxPaymobStep2: In Developers → Payment integrations, copy the integration IDs you want (card, wallet…).
admin.cxPaymobCallbackHint: Payment confirmations are sent here automatically:
admin.cxDisconnectConfirm: Disconnect and forget the saved keys?
admin.cxProviderError: The payment provider refused the request. Check your keys.
admin.cxWhatsAppHint: Send messages automatically through the official WhatsApp Business (Cloud) API, instead of tapping each one. Without this, one-tap WhatsApp links keep working.
admin.cxWaStep1: Create an app at developers.facebook.com and add the WhatsApp product (with your business number).
admin.cxWaStep2: Copy the Phone number ID and create a permanent access token (Business settings → System users).
admin.cxWaStep3: In WhatsApp Manager → Message templates, create each template below with the same text and name.
admin.cxWaStep4: When Meta approves a template, switch it on here.
admin.cxTemplatesHint: WhatsApp only allows businesses to start conversations with approved templates. Create each one with exactly this text ({{1}}, {{2}}… are filled in automatically).
admin.cxEmailHint: Any SMTP mailbox (e.g. your Hostinger email). Used for alerts, daily backups and customer emails.
admin.cxPushHint: Get an instant notification on this phone or computer, without Telegram. Turn it on from every device you use.
admin.cxIosHint: On iPhone: tap Share → Add to Home Screen, open the admin from there, then turn notifications on.
admin.cxPushDenied: Notifications are blocked in this browser’s settings.
admin.cxBackupsHint: A backup is saved on the server every day and the last {n} days are kept. Turn on “Email me the daily backup” above to keep a copy off the server too.
admin.cxNoBackups: The first automatic backup is made shortly after the app starts.
admin.cxInvalidIntegration: Integration IDs are numbers, separated by commas
admin.cxInvalidPhoneId: The Phone number ID is a long number
admin.cxInvalidTemplate: Template names use lowercase letters, numbers and _
admin.cxInvalidPhone: Enter a full number with country code
admin.cxNotReady: Fill in and save the settings first
